transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Well, I guess what brings me in is that ever since I stopped working, I just can’t seem to slow down. I’m constantly up and moving from one little job to the next all day long. It's almost like I still have a crew waiting on me, even though I don't.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual to feel fully rested?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still need my regular amount of sleep. I usually get about seven or eight hours a night, and if I don't, I definitely feel it the next day. I'm just as tired as I've always been if I don't get enough rest.

Yeah, I'd say it goes all the way back to when I was a kid. Even back in grade school, my teachers used to say I was a bright boy, but just... scattered. I was always losing my pencils, calling out answers in class, things like that. They constantly had to give me reminders to actually finish my work before I could run off for recess. So, yeah, that feeling of being on the go has pretty much always been there.
